INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvchoduyet_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO 
       - TH1: Giao trực tiếp từ 490.695% -> lấy AssignDepartment
       - TH2: Bên khác giao qua -> lấy DepartmentPath của CreateUser */
    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN t.AssignDepartment
        ELSE MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)
    END                                                     AS id_truc_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign.name))
        ELSE MAX(d_create_dept.name)
    END                                                     AS truc_giao,

    COALESCE(t.DocCode, MAX(r.DocCode))                     AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (LÙI VỀ CẤP 4 NẾU CÓ >= 4 DẤU CHẤM) */
    /* Nếu không suy được đơn vị chủ trì -> lùi về phòng ban của t.TargetUser */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
            END, ''),
        MAX(d_target_dept.departmentpath)
    )                                                       AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* Nếu không suy được đơn vị chủ trì -> lùi về phòng ban của t.TargetUser */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name),
        MAX(d_target_dept.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* LẤY DỮ LIỆU GIỐNG DON_VI_CHU_TRI */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* 5. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN & LÃNH ĐẠO BAN PHỤ TRÁCH */
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 3 TRẠNG THÁI CHỜ DUYỆT */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt quá hạn'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chờ duyệt - không có hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi báo cáo mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Content), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Difficulty), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Suggestion), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* SUBQUERY LỌC NHIỆM VỤ CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT TỪ qlnv_report */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT (Content, Difficulty, Suggestion) */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId, 
        rp.Content,
        NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') AS Difficulty,
        NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') AS Suggestion
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(CreatedDate) AS MaxCreatedDate
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.CreatedDate = rp_max.MaxCreatedDate
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN GIAO (TH1) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create_dept
       ON d_create_dept.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_create_dept.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CẤP ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (CẤP 3/4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER LẤY TÊN (CÁN BỘ GIAO VÀ NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN (t.TargetUser)
   -> fallback khi không suy được đơn vị thực hiện từ t.TargetDepartment */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_target_dept
       ON d_target_dept.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_target.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_target.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_target_dept.IsDelete = 0

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY 490.695% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.695% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.695%'
        ) 
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_nvgiao_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,
    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,
    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)
SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    MAX(t.Code)                                             AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionId),
        MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionId)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionName), '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionId)                         AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), '')           AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )

    /* ĐIỀU KIỆN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO CHÍNH XÁC 490.695 (VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY) */
    AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.695'

    /* LOẠI 3 NODE TỔNG HỢP "CÁC SỞ NGÀNH" (chung chung, không phải đơn vị thật).
       NOT IN => chỉ loại đúng 3 node này, VẪN GIỮ các đơn vị con bên dưới. */
    AND COALESCE(t.TargetDepartment, '') NOT IN (
        '490.698.1307',
        '490.698.1310',
        '490.698.1841'
    )

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID KHỬ TRÙNG LẶP TUYỆT ĐỐI */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId;

/* =======================================================================
   CHIỀU NHẬN — đơn vị = TargetDepartment
   ======================================================================= */
SELECT
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,
    'nhan'                                                  AS chieu,

    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), t.TargetDepartment)        AS ten_don_vi,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_truc.name, ''),
             SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2))   AS ten_truc,

    LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment)
        - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1  AS cap,

    /* Khóa sắp xếp: pad từng đoạn về 6 ký tự để đơn vị anh em xếp đúng thứ tự
       SỐ (không thì '1558' đứng trước '999'), con luôn nằm ngay dưới cha */
    CONCAT(
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 1), 6, '0'),
        '.',
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1), 6, '0'),
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 3
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END,
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 4
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END
    )                                                       AS thu_tu,

    COALESCE(MAX(tk.so_tai_khoan_cap), 0)                   AS so_tai_khoan_cap,
    MAX(tk.so_da_dang_nhap)                                 AS so_da_dang_nhap,

    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_doi_ung,

    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, '')
    )                                                       AS van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Compendium, '')
    )                                                       AS can_cu,

    /* Sector là cột "Lĩnh vực"; rỗng thì lấy tạm NameGroup */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Sector, ''),
        NULLIF(t.NameGroup, '')
    )                                                       AS linh_vuc,

    /* Chuyên viên = người thực hiện (TargetUser); tra không ra thì lấy
       ChargeUser (cột text tên người phụ trách) */
    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_chuyen_vien,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, '')
    )                                                       AS chuyen_vien,

    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,

    DATE(t.StartedDate)                                     AS ngay_giao,
    DATE(t.ExpireDate)                                      AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))         AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

    /* 5 TÌNH TRẠNG RỜI NHAU — thứ tự WHEN quan trọng */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'HT quá hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) <  CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* TÊN ĐƠN VỊ — join department.id = ĐOẠN CUỐI của mã.
   REGEXP chặn CAST lỗi khi đoạn cuối không phải số.
   Tra không ra thì lấy chính mã làm tên, để không mất dòng. */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d
       ON d.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      /* COALESCE: IsDelete NULL thì `= 0` trả NULL -> mất tên */
      AND COALESCE(d.IsDelete, 0) = 0

       ON d_truc.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)

  AND (

  AND (

  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

    CASE

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)

        THEN 'ĐTH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) <  CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value

Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_ubndtp (
    task_id,
    loai_nhiem_vu,
    hinh_thuc_giao,

    ben_giao_id,
    ben_giao_name,

    ben_nhan_id,
    ben_nhan_name,

    ten_task,
    nhom_nhiem_vu,
    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    van_ban_giao,
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri,
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    ngay_bat_dau,
    thoi_han,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,

    tinh_trang,
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    ld_ubnd,
    ld_van_phong_ubnd,
    ban_chuyen_mon,
    chuyen_vien_theo_doi,
    sync_date
)

SELECT
    b.task_id,
    b.loai_nhiem_vu,
    b.hinh_thuc_giao,

    b.ben_giao_id,
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.ben_giao_id, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_giao_name,

    b.final_ben_nhan_id AS ben_nhan_id,
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(
            CASE 
                /* Nếu thuộc 490.695.1558.% thì lấy ID của cấp 4 */
                WHEN b.final_ben_nhan_id LIKE '490.695.1558.%'
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', 4), '.', -1)
                ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', -1)
            END AS UNSIGNED
        )
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_nhan_name,

    b.ten_task,
    b.nhom_nhiem_vu,
    b.stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    rv.van_ban_giao,
    b.noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    /* 1. TỔ CHỨC ĐẢNG CHỦ TRÌ */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE d.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_to_chuc_dang, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS to_chuc_dang_chu_tri,

    /* 2. LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CHUYÊN VIÊN (THUỘC 490.698%) */
    ldcv.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    b.ngay_bat_dau,
    b.thoi_han,
    b.ngay_hoan_thanh,

    b.tinh_trang,
    rp.Content AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    /* 3. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND: Đúng đích danh cấp '490.698', chức danh Lãnh đạo, Level = 2
       Chức vụ hiển thị: ông Vũ Đại Thắng = 'Chủ tịch', còn lại = 'Phó Chủ tịch' */
    (
        SELECT 
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname) LIKE '%Vũ Đại Thắng%' THEN 'Chủ tịch'
                            ELSE 'Phó Chủ tịch'
                        END,
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            )
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        WHERE tu.TaskId = b.task_id
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, ''), u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
          AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
          AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
        ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ld_ubnd,

    /* LÃNH ĐẠO VĂN PHÒNG:
       - Check qlnv_task_user của nhiệm vụ, nếu có user thuộc ban LIKE '490.698.752%' thì lấy user đó
       - Ưu tiên phòng ban thật của user (u.DepartmentPath), fallback tu.DepartmentId
     */
    (
        SELECT 
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            )
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        WHERE tu.TaskId = b.task_id
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.752'
        ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ld_van_phong_ubnd,

    /* 4. BAN CHUYÊN MÔN: Phòng của chuyên viên theo dõi.
       Chỉ lấy khi là Nhiệm vụ giao VÀ người tạo thuộc Văn phòng UBND '490.698.752%' */
    CASE 
        WHEN b.loai_nhiem_vu = 'Nhiệm vụ giao'
             AND b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon LIKE '490.698.752%'
        THEN COALESCE(
                 NULLIF((
                     SELECT d.name 
                     FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
                     WHERE d.id = CASE
                             WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                             THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                             ELSE NULL
                           END
                       AND d.IsDelete = 0 
                     LIMIT 1
                 ), ''),
                 NULLIF(b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon, '')
             )
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS ban_chuyen_mon,

    /* 5. CHUYÊN VIÊN THEO DÕI: Lấy theo CreateUser.
       Chỉ lấy khi là Nhiệm vụ giao VÀ người tạo thuộc Văn phòng UBND '490.698.752%' */
    CASE 
        WHEN b.loai_nhiem_vu = 'Nhiệm vụ giao'
             AND b.dept_ban_chuyen_mon LIKE '490.698.752%'
        THEN NULLIF((
            SELECT u.eGovUserFullname 
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
            WHERE u.eGovUserId = b.CreateUser 
            ORDER BY u.Id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), '')
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS chuyen_vien_theo_doi,
    '${sync_ts}' AS sync_date

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.AssignDepartment AS ben_giao_id,
        t.AssignUser,
        t.CreateUser,
        t.OriginalTargetDepartment AS TargetDepartment_Goc,

        /* LOẠI NHIỆM VỤ */
        CASE
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ giao'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                 AND (t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ nhận'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS loai_nhiem_vu,

        /* HÌNH THỨC GIAO */
        CASE
            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') 
            THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment NOT IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN tu_check.has_user_dept = 1 THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                    ELSE 'Không qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                END

            ELSE NULL
        END AS hinh_thuc_giao,

        /* ID BÊN NHẬN */
        CASE 
            /* Nhánh 490.695.1558.% chuẩn hóa về cấp 4 */
            WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.695.1558.%'
            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)

            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
        END AS final_ben_nhan_id,

        /* TỔ CHỨC ĐẢNG CHỦ TRÌ PATH */
        CASE 
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
        END AS dept_to_chuc_dang,

        /* BAN CHUYÊN MÔN PATH */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''),
            (
                SELECT u.DepartmentPath 
                FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u 
                WHERE u.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser 
                ORDER BY u.Id DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            )
        ) AS dept_ban_chuyen_mon,

        t.Title AS ten_task,
        t.NameGroup AS nhom_nhiem_vu,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.Code, ''), CAST(t.TaskId AS CHAR)) AS stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.Title, ''), t.Content) AS noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

        t.StartedDate AS ngay_bat_dau,
        t.ExpireDate AS thoi_han,
        t.CompletedDate AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

        /* TÌNH TRẠNG */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (3, 4) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL 
                     OR DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                 )
                THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE())
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS tinh_trang

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

    /* CHECK LOG */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 1 AS has_user_dept
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        WHERE tu.DepartmentId IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
        GROUP BY tu.TaskId
    ) tu_check 
        ON tu_check.TaskId = t.TaskId

    WHERE
        t.DeletedDate IS NULL
        AND (t.Status IS NULL OR t.Status <> 5)
        AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1310', '490.698.1841')
        AND (
            (
                (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment
            )
            OR
            (
                t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                AND (t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            )
        )
) b

/* VĂN BẢN GIAO */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(r.DocCode, '')
            ORDER BY r.ResolutionId
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS van_ban_giao
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
        ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    GROUP BY tr.TaskId
) rv
    ON rv.TaskId = b.task_id

/* LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CHUYÊN VIÊN */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        x.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT x.thong_tin
            ORDER BY x.Role, x.thong_tin
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien
    FROM (
        SELECT
            tu.TaskId,
            tu.Role,
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                        NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), '')
                    )
                ), ''
            ) AS thong_tin
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u
            ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t_sub
            ON t_sub.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE (
                  COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) = '490.698'
               OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.%'
              )
          AND (
                  t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698%'
               OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE CONCAT(
                      CASE
                          WHEN t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                            OR t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                            OR t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                          THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                          ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t_sub.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                      END,
                      '%'
                  )
              )
    ) x
    WHERE x.thong_tin IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY x.TaskId
) ldcv
    ON ldcv.TaskId = b.task_id

/* BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp1.TaskId,
        rp1.Content
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(ReportId) AS MaxId
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max 
        ON rp1.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId 
       AND rp1.ReportId = rp_max.MaxId
    WHERE rp1.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp
    ON rp.TaskId = b.task_id

WHERE b.loai_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
  AND b.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định'

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    loai_nhiem_vu = VALUES(loai_nhiem_vu),
    hinh_thuc_giao = VALUES(hinh_thuc_giao),
    ben_giao_id = VALUES(ben_giao_id),
    ben_giao_name = VALUES(ben_giao_name),
    ben_nhan_id = VALUES(ben_nhan_id),
    ben_nhan_name = VALUES(ben_nhan_name),
    ten_task = VALUES(ten_task),
    nhom_nhiem_vu = VALUES(nhom_nhiem_vu),
    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi = VALUES(stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu = VALUES(noi_dung_nhiem_vu),
    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri = VALUES(to_chuc_dang_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    ngay_bat_dau = VALUES(ngay_bat_dau),
    thoi_han = VALUES(thoi_han),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong_ubnd = VALUES(ld_van_phong_ubnd),
    ban_chuyen_mon = VALUES(ban_chuyen_mon),
    chuyen_vien_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_theo_doi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1048576;

/* Gộp các nhiệm vụ giao giống nhau (cùng tên nhiệm vụ + bên giao + văn bản giao) thành 1 dòng, theo id_cha
   (id_cha = task_id nhỏ nhất của nhóm + '_GR', do luồng BTH - Details cập nhật vào bảng chi tiết).
   Logic gộp giống qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp: giống nhau giữ 1 giá trị, khác nhau nối ' | ' theo task_id. */
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_ubndtp` (
    id_cha, task_id, so_luong_task,
    loai_nhiem_vu, hinh_thuc_giao,
    ben_giao_id, ben_giao_name, ben_nhan_id, ben_nhan_name,
    ten_task, nhom_nhiem_vu, stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi, van_ban_giao, noi_dung_nhiem_vu,
    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri, lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, cap_giao_nhiem_vu, lanh_dao_giao,
    ngay_bat_dau, thoi_han, ngay_het_han, ngay_hoan_thanh, nam_het_han, thang_het_han,
    tinh_trang, tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,
    ld_ubnd, ld_van_phong_ubnd, ban_chuyen_mon, chuyen_vien_theo_doi,
    sync_date
)

SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA NHÓM */
    x.id_cha,
    GROUP_CONCAT(x.task_id ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')                          AS task_id,
    COUNT(*)                                                                            AS so_luong_task,
    MAX(x.loai_nhiem_vu)                                                                AS loai_nhiem_vu,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.hinh_thuc_giao ORDER BY x.hinh_thuc_giao SEPARATOR ' | ')  AS hinh_thuc_giao,

    /* 2. BÊN GIAO / BÊN NHẬN */
    MAX(x.ben_giao_id)                                                                  AS ben_giao_id,
    MAX(x.ben_giao_name)                                                                AS ben_giao_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ben_nhan_id   ORDER BY x.ben_nhan_id   SEPARATOR ' | ')    AS ben_nhan_id,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ben_nhan_name ORDER BY x.ben_nhan_name SEPARATOR ' | ')    AS ben_nhan_name,

    /* 3. NHIỆM VỤ & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    MAX(x.ten_task)                                                                     AS ten_task,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.nhom_nhiem_vu         ORDER BY x.nhom_nhiem_vu         SEPARATOR ' | ') AS nhom_nhiem_vu,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi ORDER BY x.stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi SEPARATOR ' | ') AS stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.van_ban_giao          ORDER BY x.van_ban_giao          SEPARATOR ' | ') AS van_ban_giao,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.noi_dung_nhiem_vu, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.noi_dung_nhiem_vu, '-')), MAX(x.noi_dung_nhiem_vu),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.noi_dung_nhiem_vu, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & LÃNH ĐẠO */
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.to_chuc_dang_chu_tri ORDER BY x.to_chuc_dang_chu_tri SEPARATOR ' | ') AS to_chuc_dang_chu_tri,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-')), MAX(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT q.cap_giao_nhiem_vu ORDER BY q.cap_giao_nhiem_vu SEPARATOR ' | ') AS cap_giao_nhiem_vu,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT q.lanh_dao_giao     ORDER BY q.lanh_dao_giao     SEPARATOR ' | ') AS lanh_dao_giao,

    /* 5. MỐC THỜI GIAN: giữ kiểu DATETIME để lọc/biểu đồ theo thời gian.
       Hạn = hạn sớm nhất của nhóm; ngày hoàn thành chỉ có khi cả nhóm đã hoàn thành */
    MIN(x.ngay_bat_dau)                                                                 AS ngay_bat_dau,
    MIN(x.thoi_han)                                                                     AS thoi_han,
    MIN(x.thoi_han)                                                                     AS ngay_het_han,
    IF(SUM(x.tinh_trang LIKE 'Hoàn thành%') = COUNT(*), MAX(x.ngay_hoan_thanh), NULL)   AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    YEAR(MIN(x.thoi_han))                                                               AS nam_het_han,
    MONTH(MIN(x.thoi_han))                                                              AS thang_het_han,

    /* 6. TÌNH TRẠNG: tình trạng xấu nhất trong nhóm
       VD: Hoàn thành đúng hạn | Đang thực hiện trong hạn => Đang thực hiện trong hạn */
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn')      = 1 THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn')    = 1 THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo') = 1 THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo')   = 1 THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Hoàn thành quá hạn')          = 1 THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn')         = 1 THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'
    END                                                                                 AS tinh_trang,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien, '-')), MAX(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    /* 7. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG & CHUYÊN VIÊN THEO DÕI */
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ld_ubnd              SEPARATOR ' | ')                       AS ld_ubnd,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ld_van_phong_ubnd    SEPARATOR ' | ')                       AS ld_van_phong_ubnd,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ban_chuyen_mon       SEPARATOR ' | ')                       AS ban_chuyen_mon,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.chuyen_vien_theo_doi SEPARATOR ' | ')                       AS chuyen_vien_theo_doi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                                        AS sync_date

FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_ubndtp` x
LEFT JOIN `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_tongquan_ubndtp` q
       ON q.task_id = x.task_id
WHERE x.id_cha IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY x.id_cha

/* UPSERT theo PK id_cha: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Nhóm không còn tồn tại bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */

    task_id = VALUES(task_id),

    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi = VALUES(stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu = VALUES(noi_dung_nhiem_vu),
    to_chuc_dang_chu_tri = VALUES(to_chuc_dang_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    cap_giao_nhiem_vu = VALUES(cap_giao_nhiem_vu),
    lanh_dao_giao = VALUES(lanh_dao_giao),
    ngay_bat_dau = VALUES(ngay_bat_dau),
    thoi_han = VALUES(thoi_han),
    ngay_het_han = VALUES(ngay_het_han),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    nam_het_han = VALUES(nam_het_han),
    thang_het_han = VALUES(thang_het_han),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong_ubnd = VALUES(ld_van_phong_ubnd),
    ban_chuyen_mon = VALUES(ban_chuyen_mon),
    chuyen_vien_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_theo_doi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

-- Bước 1: Tắt cơ chế merge subquery lỗi của MySQL 5.7
SET SESSION optimizer_switch = 'derived_merge=off';

-- Bước 2: Thực thi nạp dữ liệu chuẩn 15 cột
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_tongquan_ubndtp (
    task_id,
    ben_giao_id,
    ben_giao_name,
    ben_nhan_id,
    ben_nhan_name,
    loai_nhiem_vu,
    hinh_thuc_giao,
    cap_giao_nhiem_vu,
    lanh_dao_giao,
    ngay_bat_dau,
    ngay_het_han,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,
    nam_het_han,
    thang_het_han,
    tinh_trang,
    sync_date
)

SELECT
    b.task_id,
    b.ben_giao_id,

    /* 1. LẤY TÊN BÊN GIAO (SO SÁNH BẰNG CHAR ĐỂ TRÁNH ÉP KIỂU SỐ) */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE CAST(d.id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.ben_giao_id, '.', -1)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_giao_name,

    b.final_ben_nhan_id AS ben_nhan_id,

    /* 2. LẤY TÊN BÊN NHẬN (SO SÁNH BẰNG CHAR) */
    (
        SELECT d.name 
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.department d 
        WHERE CAST(d.id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.final_ben_nhan_id, '.', -1)
          AND d.IsDelete = 0 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS ben_nhan_name,

    b.loai_nhiem_vu,
    b.hinh_thuc_giao,
    rv.cap_giao_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255)) AS lanh_dao_giao,
    b.ngay_bat_dau,
    b.ngay_het_han,
    b.ngay_hoan_thanh,
    b.nam_het_han,
    b.thang_het_han,
    b.tinh_trang,
    '${sync_ts}' AS sync_date

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.AssignDepartment AS ben_giao_id,

        /* PHÂN LOẠI NHIỆM VỤ */
        CASE
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ giao'

            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
                 AND (t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ nhận'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS loai_nhiem_vu,

        /* HÌNH THỨC GIAO */
        CASE
            WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') 
                    THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'

                    WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%' THEN
                        CASE 
                            WHEN tu_check.has_user_dept = 1 THEN 'Giao qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                            ELSE 'Không qua Đảng ủy UBND'
                        END
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS hinh_thuc_giao,

        /* CHUẨN HÓA BÊN NHẬN ID */
        CASE 
            WHEN (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
                 AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
                 AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)

                    WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1307%' 
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                         AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                         AND (CHAR_LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)

                    ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
                END
            ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment
        END AS final_ben_nhan_id,

        t.StartedDate AS ngay_bat_dau,
        t.ExpireDate AS ngay_het_han,
        t.CompletedDate AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
        YEAR(t.ExpireDate) AS nam_het_han,
        MONTH(t.ExpireDate) AS thang_het_han,

        /* TÌNH TRẠNG */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (3, 4) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
                THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL 
                     OR DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                 )
                THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE())
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
                THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS tinh_trang

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

    /* CHECK LOG TASK_USER */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 1 AS has_user_dept
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
        WHERE tu.DepartmentId IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
        GROUP BY tu.TaskId
    ) tu_check 
        ON tu_check.TaskId = t.TaskId

    WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND (t.Status IS NULL OR t.Status <> 5)
      AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1310', '490.698.1841')
      AND (
          /* Luồng Giao: từ 1814/1815 sang 490.698% */
          (
              (t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814' OR t.AssignDepartment = '490.695.1558.1814.1815')
              AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
              AND t.AssignDepartment <> t.OriginalTargetDepartment
          )
          OR
          /* Luồng Nhận: từ 490.695% về 1814/1815 hoặc sang 490.698% */
          (
              t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' 
              AND (t.OriginalTargetDepartment IN ('490.695.1558.1814', '490.695.1558.1814.1815') OR t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%')
          )
      )
) b

/* CẤP GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr.TaskId,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(r.AssignOrganizationName, '') 
            ORDER BY r.ResolutionId 
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS cap_giao_nhiem_vu
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r 
        ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
    WHERE r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    GROUP BY tr.TaskId
) rv 
    ON rv.TaskId = b.task_id

WHERE b.loai_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
  AND b.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định'

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    ben_giao_id = VALUES(ben_giao_id),
    ben_giao_name = VALUES(ben_giao_name),
    ben_nhan_id = VALUES(ben_nhan_id),
    ben_nhan_name = VALUES(ben_nhan_name),
    loai_nhiem_vu = VALUES(loai_nhiem_vu),
    hinh_thuc_giao = VALUES(hinh_thuc_giao),
    cap_giao_nhiem_vu = VALUES(cap_giao_nhiem_vu),
    lanh_dao_giao = VALUES(lanh_dao_giao),
    ngay_bat_dau = VALUES(ngay_bat_dau),
    ngay_het_han = VALUES(ngay_het_han),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    nam_het_han = VALUES(nam_het_han),
    thang_het_han = VALUES(thang_het_han),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles
