SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1048576;

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` (
    id_truc_giao, truc_giao, nhom_van_ban, linh_vuc, chu_de, muc_do_uu_tien, nv_quantam,
    ma_nhiem_vu, ten_nhiem_vu, van_ban_giao,
    id_don_vi_chu_tri, ten_don_vi_chu_tri, lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,
    ngay_giao, han_xu_ly, ngay_hoan_thanh, ngay_xoa,
    tinh_trang, tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    ld_ubnd, ld_van_phong, phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi, chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,
    task_id, id_cha, status, sync_date
)

SELECT
    /* 1. TRỤC GIAO & NHÓM VĂN BẢN */
    t.AssignDepartment                                                      AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name)          AS truc_giao,
    /* Nhóm văn bản: gắn tên theo số ký hiệu văn bản giao (DocCode), xét theo thứ tự từ trên xuống.
       Chỉ dùng để phân nhóm, KHÔNG dùng để lọc task */
    CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%CTr%'                 THEN 'Chương trình'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%KH%'                  THEN 'Kế hoạch'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB-(VP|UBND)'        THEN 'TBKL UBND Thành phố'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'                 THEN 'Triển khai thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP '/(UBND|VP)-'         THEN 'Văn bản chỉ đạo'
        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END                                                                     AS nhom_van_ban,
    /* LĨNH VỰC: lĩnh vực văn bản (qlnv_sector qua resolution.SectorId); rỗng thì 'Khác' */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SectorName, ''), 'Khác')                              AS linh_vuc,

    /* CHỦ ĐỀ, MỨC ĐỘ ƯU TIÊN, NHIỆM VỤ QUAN TÂM */
    tp.TopicName                                                            AS chu_de,
    CASE t.Priority
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
        ELSE 'Thường'
    END                                                                     AS muc_do_uu_tien,
    t.isFocus                                                               AS nv_quantam,

    /* 2. NHIỆM VỤ & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    t.Code                                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    t.DocCode                                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: nhánh 1841/1307/1310 lấy cấp 4, còn lại cấp 3 */
    IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4),
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3))                         AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    d_chutri.name                                                           AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    ppl.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    /* 4. MỐC THỜI GIAN: Định dạng chuẩn ISO yyyy-mm-dd */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CreatedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 5. 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4) AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL                                       THEN 'Thường xuyên'
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        THEN IF(t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE(), 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn', 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn')
    END                                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 6. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ: báo cáo mới nhất, fallback nội dung task */
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT rp.Content
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
         WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
         ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC
         LIMIT 1),
        t.Content
    )                                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 7. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG & CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI */
    ppl.ld_ubnd,
    ppl.ld_van_phong,
    IF(u_create.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(d_create.name, ''), NULL)              AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    IF(u_create.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserFullname, ''), NULL)  AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    /* 8. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & ĐỒNG BỘ */
    t.TaskId                                                                AS task_id,
    /* id_cha: task_id đầu tiên (nhỏ nhất) cùng (tên nhiệm vụ, văn bản giao, trục giao) + '_GR', khớp id_cha bảng gộp */
    MAX(g.id_cha)                                                           AS id_cha,
    t.Status                                                                AS status,
    '${sync_ts}'                                                            AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* RESOLUTION */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* LĨNH VỰC VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_sector` s
       ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
      AND s.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND s.IsActive = 1

/* CHỦ ĐỀ NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` tp
       ON tp.TopicId = t.TopicId

/* TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                                CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (id cuối của mã đã chuẩn hóa cấp) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = IF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
              CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED),
              NULL)
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI TẠO & PHÒNG BAN NGƯỜI TẠO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create
       ON d_create.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI LIÊN QUAN THEO TASK */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.TaskId,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dept, u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
                  AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
                  AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698.752'
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_van_phong,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN p.src = 0
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE CONCAT(
                          IF(p.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '%')
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title,
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.Role, ujt.job_title, u.eGovUserFullname SEPARATOR ', ') AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien

    FROM (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 0 AS src, tu.Role, tu.Id, tu.UserId,
               NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '') AS dept, t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2 ON t2.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 1, NULL, NULL, t2.OriginalTargetUser, NULLIF(t2.OriginalTargetDepartment, ''), t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t2.OriginalTargetUser IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 2, NULL, NULL, t2.AssignUser, NULLIF(t2.AssignDepartment, ''), t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t2.AssignUser IS NOT NULL
    ) p
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
            ON u.eGovUserId = p.UserId

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT udpj.user_id,
               NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(MAX(CONCAT(
                   IF(CAST(udpj.department_id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(uu.DepartmentPath, '.', -1), 1, 0),
                   IF(udpj.is_primary > 0, 1, 0),
                   LPAD(udpj.id, 12, '0'),
                   COALESCE(jt.JobTitlesName, '')
               )), 15)), '') AS job_title
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`user_department_position_jobtitle` udpj
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`jobtitles` jt ON jt.JobTitlesId = udpj.jobtitle_id
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` uu ON uu.eGovUserId = udpj.user_id
        WHERE COALESCE(udpj.status, 1) = 1
        GROUP BY udpj.user_id
    ) ujt
           ON ujt.user_id = u.eGovUserId

    GROUP BY p.TaskId
) ppl
    ON ppl.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NHÓM GỘP (cùng khóa GROUP BY ten_nhiem_vu, id_truc_giao của qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp)
   Điều kiện lọc phải giữ giống hệt WHERE bên dưới để MIN(TaskId) khớp bảng gộp.
   MySQL 5.7 không có MIN() OVER (...); Title varchar(6000) không tạo được auto key cho bảng dẫn xuất
   => JOIN theo MD5(Title || DocCode) 32 ký tự (JOIN thẳng Title bị nested loop > 60s). */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MD5(CONCAT(COALESCE(t3.Title, ''), '||', COALESCE(t3.DocCode, ''))) AS title_md5, t3.AssignDepartment, CONCAT(MIN(t3.TaskId), '_GR') AS id_cha
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t3
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r3
            ON r3.ResolutionId = t3.ResolutionId
           AND r3.DeletedDate IS NULL
    WHERE t3.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND (   t3.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
           OR (t3.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t3.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t3.CompletedDate, t3.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
      AND t3.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
      AND t3.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
      AND t3.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
    GROUP BY MD5(CONCAT(COALESCE(t3.Title, ''), '||', COALESCE(t3.DocCode, ''))), t3.AssignDepartment
) g
       ON g.title_md5 = MD5(CONCAT(COALESCE(t.Title, ''), '||', COALESCE(t.DocCode, '')))
      AND g.AssignDepartment = t.AssignDepartment

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')

GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    id_truc_giao = VALUES(id_truc_giao),
    truc_giao = VALUES(truc_giao),
    nhom_van_ban = VALUES(nhom_van_ban),
    linh_vuc = VALUES(linh_vuc),
    chu_de = VALUES(chu_de),
    muc_do_uu_tien = VALUES(muc_do_uu_tien),
    nv_quantam = VALUES(nv_quantam),
    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),
    ten_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ten_nhiem_vu),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    id_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(id_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    ngay_giao = VALUES(ngay_giao),
    han_xu_ly = VALUES(han_xu_ly),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    ngay_xoa = VALUES(ngay_xoa),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong = VALUES(ld_van_phong),
    phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi = VALUES(phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi),
    chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi),
    id_cha = VALUES(id_cha),
    status = VALUES(status),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvnhan_pth_ubndtp` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(d_assign.name, NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    u_assign.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
    t.OriginalTargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''), 
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''), 
        d_cap.name,
        d_donvi.name
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    
    COALESCE(
        d_donvi.name,
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, '')
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    t.OriginalTargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    u_target.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    /* Lãnh đạo ban phụ trách */
    CONCAT_WS(' · ',
        COALESCE(u_target.eGovUserPositionName, NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
    )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN LỌC THEO NHÓM VĂN BẢN NHẬN ('55', '111', 132, 129) */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
       AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 111, 132, 129)

/* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO (BÓC TÁCH ID TỪ T.ASSIGNDEPARTMENT ĐỂ LẤY TÊN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

/* JOIN DANH MỤC PHÒNG BAN ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.OriginalTargetUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
    AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
    AND COALESCE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '') NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')

    /* LOẠI BỎ NHIỆM VỤ DO CHÍNH TRỤC 490.698 GIAO RA (UBND tự giao nội bộ) */
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

    /* CHẶN ĐIỀU KIỆN NHÓM VĂN BẢN */
    AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 111, 132, 129)
    /* NHIỆM VỤ THÀNH ỦY GIAO (490.695%): chỉ lấy khi số ký hiệu văn bản thuộc danh sách */
    AND (
        COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.695%'
        OR (
               t.DocCode LIKE '%TB/KL%'     -- TBKL Thành ủy
            OR t.DocCode LIKE '%TB/TU%'     -- TBKL Thành ủy
            OR t.DocCode LIKE '%TB/VPTU%'   -- TBKL Thành ủy
            OR t.DocCode LIKE '%CV/TU%'     -- CV Thành ủy
            OR t.DocCode LIKE '%CV/VPTU%'   -- CV Thành ủy
            OR t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'       -- Triển khai thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW
        )
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    status = VALUES(status),
    id_truc_giao = VALUES(id_truc_giao),
    truc_giao = VALUES(truc_giao),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),
    ten_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ten_nhiem_vu),
    chu_de = VALUES(chu_de),
    id_don_vi_giao = VALUES(id_don_vi_giao),
    don_vi_giao = VALUES(don_vi_giao),
    id_nguoi_giao = VALUES(id_nguoi_giao),
    nguoi_giao = VALUES(nguoi_giao),
    id_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(id_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_thuc_hien = VALUES(ten_don_vi_thuc_hien),
    id_nguoi_thuc_hien = VALUES(id_nguoi_thuc_hien),
    nguoi_thuc_hien = VALUES(nguoi_thuc_hien),
    lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach = VALUES(lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach),
    ngay_giao = VALUES(ngay_giao),
    han_xu_ly = VALUES(han_xu_ly),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    ngay_chap_nhan = VALUES(ngay_chap_nhan),
    ngay_xoa = VALUES(ngay_xoa),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    ket_qua_thuc_hien = VALUES(ket_qua_thuc_hien),
    kho_khan_vuong_mac = VALUES(kho_khan_vuong_mac),
    de_xuat_kien_nghi = VALUES(de_xuat_kien_nghi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. properties.Replacement Value:
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,

    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,

    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,

    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,

    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.fullname, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.fullname, ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(u_action.position_id, u_create.position_id)    AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.position_name, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.position_name, '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_target.fullname, ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    u_target.position_id                                    AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(u_target.position_name, '')                      AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

/* LẤY TẬP NHIỆM VỤ HỢP LỆ TRƯỚC (rất chọn lọc) RỒI MỚI BUNG RA TIMELINE */
FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ: LỌC TRỰC TIẾP ID NHÓM '55', 132 */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    --    AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 132)

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl
        ON tl.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* DANH BẠ USER ĐÃ KHỬ TRÙNG eGovUserId - CHỈ GIỮ 4 CỘT CẦN DÙNG.
   Nhờ vậy 3 LEFT JOIN dưới đây không thể nhân dòng, bỏ được GROUP BY ở ngoài. */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

/* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: đồng bộ với qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp */
WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  /* UBND giao (đúng 490.698) cho đơn vị con 490.698.x, trừ 1307 / 1841 / 1310 */
  AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
  /* Loại nhóm văn bản 82, 109 */
--   AND r.ResolutionGroupId NOT IN (82, 109)


/* UPSERT theo PK timeline_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE

    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvnhan_pth_ubndtp` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `luong_giao`,
    `nhom_van_ban`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua`,
    `ld_ubnd`,
    `ld_van_phong`,
    `phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi`,
    `chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi`,
    `sync_date`
)



SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* LUỒNG GIAO: đơn vị nhận = 490.698, hoặc qlnv_task_user có user thuộc đúng 490.698 */
    IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment = '490.698' OR MAX(ppl.co_user_ubnd) = 1,
       'Qua UBND', 'Không qua UBND')                        AS luong_giao,

    /* NHÓM VĂN BẢN: gắn tên theo số ký hiệu văn bản giao (DocCode) */
    CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB/(KL|TU|VPTU)' THEN 'TBKL Thành ủy'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'CV/(TU|VPTU)'    THEN 'CV Thành ủy'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'             THEN 'Triển khai thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS nhom_van_ban,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. NHIỆM VỤ & THÔNG TIN GIAO */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(MAX(d_assign.name), NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ / CHUYÊN VIÊN */
    t.OriginalTargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    MAX(d_chutri.name)                                      AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    MAX(ppl.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien)                 AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    /* 5. MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4) AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL                                      THEN 'Thường xuyên'
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        THEN IF(t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE(), 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn', 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn')
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ: báo cáo mới nhất, fallback nội dung task */
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT rp.Content
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
         WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
         ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC
         LIMIT 1),
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 8. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG (tính sẵn trong ppl) & CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI (người tạo thuộc 490.698.752) */
    MAX(ppl.ld_ubnd)                                        AS ld_ubnd,
    MAX(ppl.ld_van_phong)                                   AS ld_van_phong,
    IF(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(MAX(d_create.name), ''), NULL)             AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    IF(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''), NULL) AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* LỌC NHÓM VĂN BẢN 55, 111, 132, 129 */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
       AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 111, 132, 129)

/* Không dùng nữa: nhom_van_ban lấy theo DocCode
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution_group` rg
        ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
       AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL
*/

/* Các JOIN department: chỉ CAST khi id là số (INSERT ... SELECT ở strict mode sẽ lỗi nếu CAST chuỗi rỗng/không phải số) */

/* TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                                CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

/* ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: nhánh 1841/1307/1310 lấy cấp 4, còn lại lấy id cuối của TargetDepartment */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = IF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), t.OriginalTargetDepartment), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
              CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), t.OriginalTargetDepartment), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED),
              NULL)
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI TẠO & PHÒNG BAN NGƯỜI TẠO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create
       ON d_create.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI LIÊN QUAN THEO TASK: tính 1 lần cho mọi task (thay cho subquery tương quan từng dòng)
   Nguồn p.src: 0 = qlnv_task_user (đơn vị tu.DepartmentId), 1 = TargetUser (đơn vị TargetDepartment)
   - co_user_ubnd : có user qlnv_task_user thuộc đúng 490.698 (cho luong_giao)
   - ld_ubnd      : đơn vị = 490.698 (ưu tiên đơn vị của nguồn), chức danh Lãnh đạo, Level = 2
   - ld_van_phong : đơn vị = 490.698.752 (ưu tiên u.DepartmentPath)
   - lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien: chỉ qlnv_task_user, user thuộc đơn vị chủ trì
   - Trùng user giữa 2 nguồn loại bằng GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ...) */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.TaskId,
        MAX(p.src = 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698') AS co_user_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dept, u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
                  AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
                  AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698.752'
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_van_phong,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN p.src = 0
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE '490.698%'
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE CONCAT(
                          IF(p.OriginalTargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), p.OriginalTargetDepartment), '%')
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title,
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.Role, ujt.job_title, u.eGovUserFullname SEPARATOR ', ') AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien

    FROM (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 0 AS src, tu.Role, tu.Id, tu.UserId,
               NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '') AS dept, t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2 ON t2.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE t2.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
          AND COALESCE(t2.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 1, NULL, NULL, t2.OriginalTargetUser,
               NULLIF(t2.OriginalTargetDepartment, ''), t2.OriginalTargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND t2.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
          AND COALESCE(t2.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
          AND t2.OriginalTargetUser IS NOT NULL
    ) p
    /* LEFT JOIN: giữ dòng task_user không có user (co_user_ubnd vẫn xét tu.DepartmentId) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
           ON u.eGovUserId = p.UserId

    /* CHỨC DANH MỖI USER (tính 1 lần): đúng phòng ban hiện tại > is_primary > id mới nhất.
       MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER -> ghép khóa sắp xếp cố định 14 ký tự rồi lấy MAX */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT udpj.user_id,
               NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(MAX(CONCAT(
                   IF(CAST(udpj.department_id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(uu.DepartmentPath, '.', -1), 1, 0),
                   IF(udpj.is_primary > 0, 1, 0),
                   LPAD(udpj.id, 12, '0'),
                   COALESCE(jt.JobTitlesName, '')
               )), 15)), '') AS job_title
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`user_department_position_jobtitle` udpj
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`jobtitles` jt ON jt.JobTitlesId = udpj.jobtitle_id
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` uu ON uu.eGovUserId = udpj.user_id
        WHERE COALESCE(udpj.status, 1) = 1
        GROUP BY udpj.user_id
    ) ujt
           ON ujt.user_id = u.eGovUserId

    GROUP BY p.TaskId
) ppl
    ON ppl.TaskId = t.TaskId

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
  AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'
  /* NHIỆM VỤ THÀNH ỦY GIAO (490.695%): chỉ lấy khi DocCode là TBKL / CV Thành ủy / NQ 57-NQ/TW */
  AND (   COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.695%'
       OR t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB/(KL|TU|VPTU)|CV/(TU|VPTU)|BCĐ')

GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    status = VALUES(status),
    luong_giao = VALUES(luong_giao),
    nhom_van_ban = VALUES(nhom_van_ban),
    id_truc_giao = VALUES(id_truc_giao),
    truc_giao = VALUES(truc_giao),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),
    ten_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ten_nhiem_vu),
    id_don_vi_giao = VALUES(id_don_vi_giao),
    don_vi_giao = VALUES(don_vi_giao),
    id_nguoi_giao = VALUES(id_nguoi_giao),
    nguoi_giao = VALUES(nguoi_giao),
    id_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(id_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    ngay_giao = VALUES(ngay_giao),
    han_xu_ly = VALUES(han_xu_ly),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    ngay_xoa = VALUES(ngay_xoa),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong = VALUES(ld_van_phong),
    phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi = VALUES(phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi),
    chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvchoduyet_pth_ubndtp` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO 
       - TH1: Giao trực tiếp từ 490.698.752% -> lấy AssignDepartment
       - TH2: Bên khác giao qua -> lấy DepartmentPath của CreateUser */
    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752%' THEN t.AssignDepartment
        ELSE MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)
    END                                                     AS id_truc_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752%' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign.name))
        ELSE MAX(d_create_dept.name)
    END                                                     AS truc_giao,

    COALESCE(t.DocCode, MAX(r.DocCode))                     AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(MAX(d_assign.name), NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    MAX(u_nguoi_giao.eGovUserFullname)                      AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (LÙI VỀ CẤP 4 NẾU CÓ >= 4 DẤU CHẤM) */
    CASE 
        WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
    END                                                     AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* LẤY DỮ LIỆU GIỐNG DON_VI_CHU_TRI */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* 5. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN & LÃNH ĐẠO BAN PHỤ TRÁCH */
    t.OriginalTargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 3 TRẠNG THÁI CHỜ DUYỆT */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt quá hạn'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chờ duyệt - không có hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi báo cáo mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Content), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Difficulty), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Suggestion), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* SUBQUERY LỌC NHIỆM VỤ CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT TỪ qlnv_report */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT (Content, Difficulty, Suggestion) */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId, 
        rp.Content,
        NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') AS Difficulty,
        NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') AS Suggestion
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(CreatedDate) AS MaxCreatedDate
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.CreatedDate = rp_max.MaxCreatedDate
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN GIAO (TH1) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create_dept
       ON d_create_dept.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_create_dept.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CẤP ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (CẤP 3/4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER LẤY TÊN (CÁN BỘ GIAO VÀ NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.OriginalTargetUser

/* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ (AssignUser; u_assign ở trên là CreateUser) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_nguoi_giao
       ON u_nguoi_giao.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ PHÒNG BAN 490.698.752% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.698.752% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%'
        ) 
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    status = VALUES(status),
    id_truc_giao = VALUES(id_truc_giao),
    truc_giao = VALUES(truc_giao),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),
    ten_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ten_nhiem_vu),
    chu_de = VALUES(chu_de),
    id_don_vi_giao = VALUES(id_don_vi_giao),
    don_vi_giao = VALUES(don_vi_giao),
    id_nguoi_giao = VALUES(id_nguoi_giao),
    nguoi_giao = VALUES(nguoi_giao),
    id_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(id_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_thuc_hien = VALUES(ten_don_vi_thuc_hien),
    id_nguoi_thuc_hien = VALUES(id_nguoi_thuc_hien),
    nguoi_thuc_hien = VALUES(nguoi_thuc_hien),
    lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach = VALUES(lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach),
    ngay_giao = VALUES(ngay_giao),
    han_xu_ly = VALUES(han_xu_ly),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    ngay_chap_nhan = VALUES(ngay_chap_nhan),
    ngay_xoa = VALUES(ngay_xoa),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    ket_qua_thuc_hien = VALUES(ket_qua_thuc_hien),
    kho_khan_vuong_mac = VALUES(kho_khan_vuong_mac),
    de_xuat_kien_nghi = VALUES(de_xuat_kien_nghi),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitietvb_pth_ubndtp` (
    `year_key`,
    `resolution_id`,
    `resolution_group_id`,
    `compendium`,
    `doc_code`,
    `kieu_van_ban`,
    `linh_vuc`,
    `ngay_van_ban`,
    `co_quan_ban_hanh`,
    `loai_cap_cha`,
    `loai_cap`,
    `id_don_vi_cap_tren`,
    `id_don_vi`,
    `don_vi`,
    `ten_viet_tat`,
    `nguoi_tao_id`,
    `nguoi_tao_tai_khoan`,
    `nguoi_tao_ten`,
    `so_nhiem_vu`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       CHIỀU THỜI GIAN
       ===================================================== */
    YEAR(r.StartDate)                                   AS year_key,

    /* =====================================================
       VĂN BẢN / NGHỊ QUYẾT
       ===================================================== */
    r.ResolutionId                                      AS resolution_id,
    r.ResolutionGroupId                                 AS resolution_group_id,
    r.Compendium                                        AS compendium,
    r.DocCode                                           AS doc_code,

    /* =====================================================
       KIỂU VĂN BẢN / LĨNH VỰC
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rg.Name, ''), 'Khác')               AS kieu_van_ban,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SectorName, ''), 'Khác')          AS linh_vuc,

    /* =====================================================
       NGÀY VĂN BẢN (dd/mm/yyyy)
       ===================================================== */
    DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_van_ban,

    /* =====================================================
       CƠ QUAN BAN HÀNH
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(r.AssignOrganizationName, ''),
        NULLIF(r.AssignOrganization, '')
    )                                                   AS co_quan_ban_hanh,

    /* =====================================================
       CẤP ĐƠN VỊ TỪ DepartmentPath CỦA NGƯỜI TẠO (u.DepartmentPath)
       ===================================================== */
    d_capcha.name                                       AS loai_cap_cha,
    d_cap.name                                          AS loai_cap,

    /* ID Đơn vị cấp trên (segment kế cuối của path người tạo) */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -2),
            '.',
            1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi_cap_tren,

    /* ID Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về lấy ID cấp 4, còn lại lấy cấp cuối */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
            END,
            '.',
            -1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi,

    /* Tên đơn vị và tên viết tắt (Tự động ăn theo cấp 4 khi là cấp 5) */
    d_donvi.name                                        AS don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_donvi.shortname, ''), d_donvi.name) AS ten_viet_tat,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI TẠO VĂN BẢN (Từ qlnv_user theo r.CreateUser)
       ===================================================== */
    r.CreateUser                                        AS nguoi_tao_id,
    u.UserName                                          AS nguoi_tao_tai_khoan,
    u.eGovUserFullname                                  AS nguoi_tao_ten,

    /* =====================================================
       SỐ NHIỆM VỤ GẮN VỚI VĂN BẢN (ĐẾM TRỰC TIẾP TỪ qlnv_task)
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(tc.so_nhiem_vu, 0)                         AS so_nhiem_vu,

    /* Thời điểm đồng bộ */
    '${sync_ts}'                                               AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r

/* Nhóm / Kiểu văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution_group` rg
       ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
      AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Lĩnh vực (Chỉ cần IS NULL vì DeletedDate là kiểu DATETIME) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_sector` s
       ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
      AND s.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Thông tin tài khoản người tạo văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
       ON u.eGovUserId = r.CreateUser

/* Cấp cha (segment 2 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_capcha
       ON d_capcha.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_capcha.IsDelete = 0

/* Cấp (segment 3 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 3), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về Map với danh mục Cấp 4 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                    ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* =========================================================
   SUBQUERY: ĐẾM NHIỆM VỤ THEO ResolutionId VÀ LỌC TÌNH TRẠNG XÁC ĐỊNH
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        t.ResolutionId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
    WHERE t.ResolutionId IS NOT NULL 
      AND t.ResolutionId > 0
      AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND t.Status != 5  /* Bỏ qua nhiệm vụ thu hồi */
      /* Chỉ lấy nhiệm vụ có tình trạng xác định rõ ràng */
      AND (
          t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
          OR (
              t.Status IN (3, 4) 
              AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        t.ResolutionId
) tc
    ON tc.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId

WHERE
    r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    /* Lọc theo cây phân cấp đơn vị của người tạo văn bản */
    AND u.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%'
    -- AND COALESCE(tc.so_nhiem_vu, 0) > 0

/* UPSERT theo PK resolution_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    year_key = VALUES(year_key),
    resolution_group_id = VALUES(resolution_group_id),
    compendium = VALUES(compendium),
    doc_code = VALUES(doc_code),
    kieu_van_ban = VALUES(kieu_van_ban),
    linh_vuc = VALUES(linh_vuc),
    ngay_van_ban = VALUES(ngay_van_ban),
    co_quan_ban_hanh = VALUES(co_quan_ban_hanh),
    loai_cap_cha = VALUES(loai_cap_cha),
    loai_cap = VALUES(loai_cap),
    id_don_vi_cap_tren = VALUES(id_don_vi_cap_tren),
    id_don_vi = VALUES(id_don_vi),
    don_vi = VALUES(don_vi),
    ten_viet_tat = VALUES(ten_viet_tat),
    nguoi_tao_id = VALUES(nguoi_tao_id),
    nguoi_tao_tai_khoan = VALUES(nguoi_tao_tai_khoan),
    nguoi_tao_ten = VALUES(nguoi_tao_ten),
    so_nhiem_vu = VALUES(so_nhiem_vu),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).
