        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    /* PHÒNG BAN: cấp cuối của đơn vị giao, không thuộc phòng ban thì lấy từ người duyệt báo cáo */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(
        IF(t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%', t.AssignDepartment, NULL),
        (SELECT MIN(u_app.DepartmentPath)
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
         INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                 ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
         WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
           AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
           AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752.%')
    ), '.', -1)                                             AS id_phong_ban,
    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

/* JOIN BẢNG NHIỆM VỤ GỐC */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

/* SUBQUERY LỌC CÁC TASK ĐANG CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN USER THỰC HIỆN ACTION */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

/* JOIN USER TẠO TIMELINE (FALLBACK KHI tl.UserId NULL) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

/* JOIN USER NHẬN TIMELINE */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ PHÒNG BAN 490.698.752% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.698.752% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752.%'
        ) 
    )

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID KHỬ TRÙNG LẶP TUYỆT ĐỐI */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    `timeline_id` = VALUES(`timeline_id`),
    `task_id` = VALUES(`task_id`),
    `ma_nhiem_vu` = VALUES(`ma_nhiem_vu`),
    `nguoi_xu_ly_id` = VALUES(`nguoi_xu_ly_id`),
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name` = VALUES(`nguoi_xu_ly_name`),
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id` = VALUES(`nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`),
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name` = VALUES(`nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`),
    `nguoi_nhan_id` = VALUES(`nguoi_nhan_id`),
    `nguoi_nhan_name` = VALUES(`nguoi_nhan_name`),
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id` = VALUES(`nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`),
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name` = VALUES(`nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`),
    `role` = VALUES(`role`),
    `action_type` = VALUES(`action_type`),
    `ten_action_type` = VALUES(`ten_action_type`),
    `noi_dung` = VALUES(`noi_dung`),
    `action_date` = VALUES(`action_date`),
    `id_phong_ban` = VALUES(`id_phong_ban`),
    `sync_date` = VALUES(`sync_date`);

SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1048576;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitietvb_phongban_ubndtp` (
    `year_key`,
    `resolution_id`,
    `resolution_group_id`,
    `compendium`,
    `doc_code`,
    `kieu_van_ban`,
    `linh_vuc`,
    `ngay_van_ban`,
    `co_quan_ban_hanh`,
    `loai_cap_cha`,
    `loai_cap`,
    `id_don_vi_cap_tren`,
    `id_don_vi`,
    `don_vi`,
    `ten_viet_tat`,
    `nguoi_tao_id`,
    `nguoi_tao_tai_khoan`,
    `nguoi_tao_ten`,
    `so_nhiem_vu`,
    `id_phong_ban`,
    `sync_date`
)
SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       CHIỀU THỜI GIAN
       ===================================================== */
    YEAR(r.StartDate)                                   AS year_key,

    /* =====================================================
       VĂN BẢN / NGHỊ QUYẾT
       ===================================================== */
    r.ResolutionId                                      AS resolution_id,
    r.ResolutionGroupId                                 AS resolution_group_id,
    r.Compendium                                        AS compendium,
    r.DocCode                                           AS doc_code,

    /* =====================================================
       KIỂU VĂN BẢN / LĨNH VỰC
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rg.Name, ''), 'Khác')               AS kieu_van_ban,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SectorName, ''), 'Khác')          AS linh_vuc,

    /* =====================================================
       NGÀY VĂN BẢN (dd/mm/yyyy)
       ===================================================== */
    DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_van_ban,

    /* =====================================================
       CƠ QUAN BAN HÀNH
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(r.AssignOrganizationName, ''),
        NULLIF(r.AssignOrganization, '')
    )                                                   AS co_quan_ban_hanh,

    /* =====================================================
       CẤP ĐƠN VỊ TỪ DepartmentPath CỦA NGƯỜI TẠO (u.DepartmentPath)
       ===================================================== */
    d_capcha.name                                       AS loai_cap_cha,
    d_cap.name                                          AS loai_cap,

    /* ID Đơn vị cấp trên (segment kế cuối của path người tạo) */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -2),
            '.',
            1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi_cap_tren,

    /* ID Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về lấy ID cấp 4, còn lại lấy cấp cuối */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
            END,
            '.',
            -1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi,

    /* Tên đơn vị và tên viết tắt (Tự động ăn theo cấp 4 khi là cấp 5) */
    d_donvi.name                                        AS don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_donvi.shortname, ''), d_donvi.name) AS ten_viet_tat,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI TẠO VĂN BẢN (Từ qlnv_user theo r.CreateUser)
       ===================================================== */
    r.CreateUser                                        AS nguoi_tao_id,
    u.UserName                                          AS nguoi_tao_tai_khoan,
    u.eGovUserFullname                                  AS nguoi_tao_ten,

    /* =====================================================
       SỐ NHIỆM VỤ GẮN VỚI VĂN BẢN (ĐẾM TRỰC TIẾP TỪ qlnv_task)
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(tc.so_nhiem_vu, 0)                         AS so_nhiem_vu,

    /* PHÒNG BAN: cấp cuối DepartmentPath của người tạo văn bản */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -1)              AS id_phong_ban,
    /* Thời điểm đồng bộ */
    '${sync_ts}'                                               AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r

/* Nhóm / Kiểu văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution_group` rg
       ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
      AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* LĨNH VỰC VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_sector` s
       ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
      AND s.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND s.IsActive = 1

/* Thông tin tài khoản người tạo văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
       ON u.eGovUserId = r.CreateUser

/* Cấp cha (segment 2 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_capcha
       ON d_capcha.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_capcha.IsDelete = 0

/* Cấp (segment 3 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 3), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về Map với danh mục Cấp 4 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                    ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* =========================================================
   SUBQUERY: ĐẾM NHIỆM VỤ THEO ResolutionId VÀ LỌC TÌNH TRẠNG XÁC ĐỊNH
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        t.ResolutionId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
    WHERE t.ResolutionId IS NOT NULL 
      AND t.ResolutionId > 0
      AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND t.Status != 5  /* Bỏ qua nhiệm vụ thu hồi */
      /* Chỉ lấy nhiệm vụ có tình trạng xác định rõ ràng */
      AND (
          t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
          OR (
              t.Status IN (3, 4) 
              AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        t.ResolutionId
) tc
    ON tc.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId

WHERE
    r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    /* Lọc theo cây phân cấp đơn vị của người tạo văn bản */
    AND u.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752.%'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    `year_key` = VALUES(`year_key`),
    `resolution_group_id` = VALUES(`resolution_group_id`),
    `compendium` = VALUES(`compendium`),
    `doc_code` = VALUES(`doc_code`),
    `kieu_van_ban` = VALUES(`kieu_van_ban`),
    `linh_vuc` = VALUES(`linh_vuc`),
    `ngay_van_ban` = VALUES(`ngay_van_ban`),
    `co_quan_ban_hanh` = VALUES(`co_quan_ban_hanh`),
    `loai_cap_cha` = VALUES(`loai_cap_cha`),
    `loai_cap` = VALUES(`loai_cap`),
    `id_don_vi_cap_tren` = VALUES(`id_don_vi_cap_tren`),
    `id_don_vi` = VALUES(`id_don_vi`),
    `don_vi` = VALUES(`don_vi`),
    `ten_viet_tat` = VALUES(`ten_viet_tat`),
    `nguoi_tao_id` = VALUES(`nguoi_tao_id`),
    `nguoi_tao_tai_khoan` = VALUES(`nguoi_tao_tai_khoan`),
    `nguoi_tao_ten` = VALUES(`nguoi_tao_ten`),
    `so_nhiem_vu` = VALUES(`so_nhiem_vu`),
    `id_phong_ban` = VALUES(`id_phong_ban`),
    `sync_date` = VALUES(`sync_date`);

    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `id_van_ban_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `han_hoan_thanh`,
    `trang_thai`,
    `id_phong_ban_giao`,
    `phong_ban_giao`,
    `id_can_bo_giao`,
    `can_bo_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `id_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `don_vi`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua`,
    `id_phong_ban`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       1. THÔNG TIN KHÓA & MÃ / TÊN NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       2. VĂN BẢN GIAO & THỜI HẠN
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(t.ResolutionId, MAX(r.ResolutionId))           AS id_van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(t.DocCode, MAX(r.DocCode))                     AS van_ban_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_hoan_thanh,

    /* =====================================================
       3. TRẠNG THÁI CHỜ PHÊ DUYỆT (TRONG HẠN / QUÁ HẠN)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt quá hạn'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chờ duyệt - không có hạn'
    END                                                     AS trang_thai,

    /* =====================================================
       4. PHÒNG BAN GIAO & CÁN BỘ GIAO (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    -- TH1: Giao trực tiếp từ 490.698.752% -> lấy AssignDepartment (5 cấp thì lùi về cấp 4)
    -- TH2: Bên khác giao qua -> lấy DepartmentPath của CreateUser (5 cấp thì lùi về cấp 4)
    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 4)
                ELSE t.AssignDepartment 
            END
        ELSE 
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath), '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath), '.', 4)
                ELSE MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)
            END
    END                                                     AS id_phong_ban_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%' THEN 
            CASE
                WHEN (LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN COALESCE(MAX(d_assign.name), NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''))
                ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign.name))
            END
        ELSE MAX(d_create_dept.name)
    END                                                     AS phong_ban_giao,

    t.CreateUser                                            AS id_can_bo_giao,
    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS can_bo_giao,

    /* =====================================================
       5. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE 
        WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
    END                                                     AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS don_vi_chu_tri,

    t.OriginalTargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(d_donvi.name)                                       AS don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* =====================================================
       6. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    t.OriginalTargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    /* =====================================================
       7. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Content), 
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* PHÒNG BAN: cấp cuối của đơn vị giao, không thuộc phòng ban thì lấy từ người duyệt báo cáo */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(
        IF(t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%', t.AssignDepartment, NULL),
        (SELECT MIN(u_app.DepartmentPath)
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
         INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                 ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
         WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
           AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
           AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752.%')
    ), '.', -1)                                             AS id_phong_ban,
    /* Thời điểm đồng bộ */
    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* SUBQUERY LỌC NHIỆM VỤ CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT TỪ qlnv_report */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId, 
        rp.Content
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(CreatedDate) AS MaxCreatedDate
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.CreatedDate = rp_max.MaxCreatedDate
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN GIAO (TH1: NẾU CÓ 5 CẤP THÌ LẤY ID CẤP 4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.AssignDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.AssignDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            ) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2: NẾU CÓ 5 CẤP THÌ LẤY ID CẤP 4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create_dept
       ON d_create_dept.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(u_create.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                    ELSE u_create.DepartmentPath 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(u_create.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                        ELSE u_create.DepartmentPath 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            ) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_create_dept.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CẤP ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (CẤP 3/4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.OriginalTargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.OriginalTargetDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER LẤY TÊN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.OriginalTargetUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ PHÒNG BAN 490.698.752% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.698.752% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752.%'
        ) 
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    `task_id` = VALUES(`task_id`),
    `ma_nhiem_vu` = VALUES(`ma_nhiem_vu`),
    `ten_nhiem_vu` = VALUES(`ten_nhiem_vu`),
    `id_van_ban_giao` = VALUES(`id_van_ban_giao`),
    `van_ban_giao` = VALUES(`van_ban_giao`),
    `han_hoan_thanh` = VALUES(`han_hoan_thanh`),
    `trang_thai` = VALUES(`trang_thai`),
    `id_phong_ban_giao` = VALUES(`id_phong_ban_giao`),
    `phong_ban_giao` = VALUES(`phong_ban_giao`),
    `id_can_bo_giao` = VALUES(`id_can_bo_giao`),
    `can_bo_giao` = VALUES(`can_bo_giao`),
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri` = VALUES(`id_don_vi_chu_tri`),
    `don_vi_chu_tri` = VALUES(`don_vi_chu_tri`),
    `id_don_vi_thuc_hien` = VALUES(`id_don_vi_thuc_hien`),
    `don_vi` = VALUES(`don_vi`),
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien` = VALUES(`id_nguoi_thuc_hien`),
    `nguoi_thuc_hien` = VALUES(`nguoi_thuc_hien`),
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua` = VALUES(`tinh_hinh_ket_qua`),
    `id_phong_ban` = VALUES(`id_phong_ban`),
    `sync_date` = VALUES(`sync_date`);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_lichsutiendo_banTCTW (
    timeline_id,
    task_id,
    ma_nhiem_vu,

    nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    nguoi_xu_ly_name,
    nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,
    nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    nguoi_nhan_id,
    nguoi_nhan_name,
    nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    role,
    action_type,

    noi_dung,
    action_date
)

SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       TIMELINE / TASK
       ===================================================== */
    tl.TimelineId AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId     AS task_id,

    /* MÃ NHIỆM VỤ */
    t.Code        AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI XỬ LÝ
       Ưu tiên UserId
       Nếu UserId NULL thì lấy CreateUser
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        tl.UserId,
        tl.CreateUser
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                tl.UserId,
                tl.CreateUser
            ) AS CHAR
        )
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    /* Vai trò / chức vụ người xử lý */
    COALESCE(
        u_action.eGovUserPositionId,
        u_create.eGovUserPositionId
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.eGovUserPositionName, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserPositionName, '')
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI NHẬN
       ===================================================== */
    tl.TargetUserId AS nguoi_nhan_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_target.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    ) AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    /* Vai trò / chức vụ người nhận */
    u_target.eGovUserPositionId
        AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,

    NULLIF(
        u_target.eGovUserPositionName,
        ''
    ) AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    /* =====================================================
       ROLE CỦA TIMELINE
       Giữ riêng, không dùng làm chức vụ
       ===================================================== */
    tl.Role AS role,

    /* =====================================================
       LOẠI HÀNH ĐỘNG
       ===================================================== */
    tl.ActionType AS action_type,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG
       ===================================================== */
    tl.Content AS noi_dung,

    /* =====================================================
       THỜI GIAN
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        tl.ActionDate,
        tl.CreatedDate
    ) AS action_date

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_timeline tl

/* =========================================================
   TASK
   ========================================================= */
INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
    ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

/* =========================================================
   USER: qlnv_user bị trùng eGovUserId (id 0 có ~174 dòng, vài id 2-3 dòng)
   => gom 1 dòng / eGovUserId để không nhân bản timeline (Duplicate entry PRIMARY timeline_id)
   ========================================================= */
/* =========================================================
   USER THỰC HIỆN ACTION
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_action
    ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

/* =========================================================
   USER TẠO TIMELINE
   fallback khi tl.UserId NULL
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_create
    ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

/* =========================================================
   USER NHẬN / ĐƯỢC GIAO
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_target
    ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* =====================================================
       KHÔNG LẤY TASK CÓ TRẠNG THÁI "CHƯA XÁC ĐỊNH"
       ===================================================== */
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)

        OR

        (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (
                t.ExpireDate IS NULL

                OR COALESCE(
                    t.CompletedDate,
                    t.ApprovedDate
                ) IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
    );

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitietnv_banTCTW (
    task_id,
    ma_nhiem_vu,

    roadmap_id,
    thu_tu_moc,
    ten_moc,
    step_key,
    han_moc,
    han_moc_text,

    nguoi_duyet_moc_id,
    nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

    roadmap_status,
    last_report_id,
    roadmap_note,
    roadmap_created_date,
    roadmap_updated_date,

    tinh_trang_moc,
    da_bao_cao,
    tinh_trang_han_moc,

    report_id,
    report_type,
    report_status,
    report_progress,
    report_content,
    report_ket_qua,
    report_kho_khan,
    report_kien_nghi,
    report_created_date,
    report_updated_date,

    trang_thai
)

SELECT
    x.task_id,
    x.ma_nhiem_vu,

    x.roadmap_id,
    x.thu_tu_moc,
    x.ten_moc,
    x.step_key,
    x.han_moc,
    x.han_moc_text,

    x.nguoi_duyet_moc_id,
    x.nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

    x.roadmap_status,
    x.last_report_id,
    x.roadmap_note,
    x.roadmap_created_date,
    x.roadmap_updated_date,

    x.tinh_trang_moc,
    x.da_bao_cao,
    x.tinh_trang_han_moc,

    x.report_id,
    x.report_type,
    x.report_status,
    x.report_progress,
    x.report_content,
    x.report_ket_qua,
    x.report_kho_khan,
    x.report_kien_nghi,
    x.report_created_date,
    x.report_updated_date,

    x.trang_thai

FROM (
    SELECT
        /* =====================================================
           A. NHIỆM VỤ
           ===================================================== */
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.Code   AS ma_nhiem_vu,

        /* =====================================================
           B. LỘ TRÌNH TRIỂN KHAI
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.RoadmapId AS roadmap_id,
        roadmap.StepOrder AS thu_tu_moc,
        roadmap.StepName AS ten_moc,
        roadmap.StepKey AS step_key,
        roadmap.DueDate AS han_moc,
        roadmap.DueDateText AS han_moc_text,

        /* =====================================================
           C. NGƯỜI DUYỆT / PHỤ TRÁCH MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.ApproverUserId AS nguoi_duyet_moc_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(roadmap_approver.eGovUserFullname, ''),
            CAST(roadmap.ApproverUserId AS CHAR)
        ) AS nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

        /* =====================================================
           D. ROADMAP
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.Status AS roadmap_status,
        roadmap.LastReportId AS last_report_id,
        roadmap.Note AS roadmap_note,
        roadmap.CreatedDate AS roadmap_created_date,
        roadmap.UpdatedDate AS roadmap_updated_date,

        /* =====================================================
           E. ĐÃ BÁO CÁO / CHƯA BÁO CÁO
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.RoadmapId IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Đã báo cáo'

            ELSE 'Chưa báo cáo'
        END AS tinh_trang_moc,

        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS da_bao_cao,

        /* =====================================================
           F. TÌNH TRẠNG HẠN MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.DueDate IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NULL
                 AND DATE(roadmap.DueDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN CONCAT(
                'Còn ',
                DATEDIFF(
                    DATE(roadmap.DueDate),
                    CURDATE()
                ),
                ' ngày'
            )

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NULL
                 AND DATE(roadmap.DueDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN CONCAT(
                'Quá hạn ',
                ABS(
                    DATEDIFF(
                        DATE(roadmap.DueDate),
                        CURDATE()
                    )
                ),
                ' ngày'
            )

            ELSE 'Đã báo cáo'
        END AS tinh_trang_han_moc,

        /* =====================================================
           G. REPORT CUỐI CÙNG CỦA MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap_report.ReportId AS report_id,
        roadmap_report.Type AS report_type,
        roadmap_report.Status AS report_status,
        roadmap_report.Progress AS report_progress,
        roadmap_report.Content AS report_content,
        roadmap_report.CompletedProduct AS report_ket_qua,
        roadmap_report.Difficulty AS report_kho_khan,
        roadmap_report.Suggestion AS report_kien_nghi,
        roadmap_report.CreatedDate AS report_created_date,
        roadmap_report.UpdatedDate AS report_updated_date,

        /* =====================================================
           H. TRẠNG THÁI NHIỆM VỤ
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ĐÚNG HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(
                        t.CompletedDate,
                        t.ApprovedDate
                     ) IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(
                        COALESCE(
                            t.CompletedDate,
                            t.ApprovedDate
                        )
                     ) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH QUÁ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(
                        t.CompletedDate,
                        t.ApprovedDate
                     ) IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(
                        COALESCE(
                            t.CompletedDate,
                            t.ApprovedDate
                        )
                     ) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH KHÔNG CÓ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành - không có hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH TRONG HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH QUÁ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH KHÔNG CÓ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành - không có hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS trang_thai


    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t


    /* =========================================================
       TASK -> ROADMAP
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_roadmap roadmap
        ON roadmap.TaskId = t.TaskId
       AND roadmap.DeletedDate IS NULL


    /* =========================================================
       NGƯỜI DUYỆT / PHỤ TRÁCH MỐC
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user roadmap_approver
        ON CAST(roadmap_approver.eGovUserId AS CHAR)
         = CAST(roadmap.ApproverUserId AS CHAR)


    /* =========================================================
       REPORT CUỐI CÙNG CỦA MỐC
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report roadmap_report
        ON roadmap_report.ReportId = roadmap.LastReportId
       AND roadmap_report.DeletedDate IS NULL


    /* =========================================================
       TASK DO 900000 GIAO
       ========================================================= */
    WHERE
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
        AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
        AND t.Status <> 5

) x

/* =========================================================
   KHÔNG INSERT NHIỆM VỤ "CHƯA XÁC ĐỊNH"
   ========================================================= */
WHERE x.trang_thai <> 'Chưa xác định';

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_banTCTW (
    task_id,
	parent_id,
	resolution_id,
	resolution_compendium,
    ma_nhiem_vu,
    ten_cap_trinh,
    ten_nhiem_vu,

    don_vi_chu_tri_id,
    don_vi_chu_tri_name,

    phong_ban_id,
    phong_ban_name,

    lanh_dao_don_vi_id,
    lanh_dao_don_vi_name,

    de_an,

    chu_de_id,
    chu_de_name,

    ld_phu_trach_id,
    ld_phu_trach_name,

    loai_van_ban_id,
    loai_van_ban_name,

    van_ban_giao,
    don_vi_phoi_hop,

    nguoi_thuc_hien_id,
    nguoi_thuc_hien_name,

    ket_qua,
    kho_khan,
    kien_nghi,

    han_hoan_thanh,
    trang_thai,

    so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
    so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
    so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

    bao_cao_cho_duyet_gan_nhat,
    ngay_yeu_cau_bao_cao_gan_nhat
)


SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       TASK ID
       ===================================================== */
    t.TaskId AS task_id,
    t.ParentId AS parent_id,
	COALESCE(tr.ResolutionId, t.ResolutionId) AS resolution_id,
    NULLIF(r.Compendium, '')                  AS resolution_compendium,

    /* =====================================================
       MÃ NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    t.Code AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       CẤP TRÌNH
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BTCTW%'
          OR t.Code LIKE '%TX%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban tổ chức Trung ương'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BCT%'
            THEN 'Trình Bộ Chính trị'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BBT%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban Bí thư'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%TW%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban chấp hành Trung ương'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS ten_cap_trinh,

    /* =====================================================
       TÊN NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    NULLIF(t.Title, '') AS ten_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetDepartment AS don_vi_chu_tri_id,
    target_dept.name   AS don_vi_chu_tri_name,

    /* =====================================================
       PHÒNG BAN
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetDepartment AS phong_ban_id,
    target_dept.name   AS phong_ban_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ
       ===================================================== */
    t.AssignDepartment AS lanh_dao_don_vi_id,
    assign_dept.name   AS lanh_dao_don_vi_name,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐỀ ÁN
       ===================================================== */
    t.NameGroup AS de_an,

    /* =====================================================
       CHỦ ĐỀ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TopicId AS chu_de_id,
    t.Sector  AS chu_de_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LÃNH ĐẠO PHỤ TRÁCH
       ===================================================== */
    t.AssignUser AS ld_phu_trach_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(assign_user.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(t.AssignUser AS CHAR)
    ) AS ld_phu_trach_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LOẠI VĂN BẢN
       ===================================================== */
    file_info.loai_van_ban_id,
    file_info.loai_van_ban_name,

    /* =====================================================
       VĂN BẢN GIAO
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, ''),
        NULLIF(r.DocCode, '')
    ) AS van_ban_giao,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐƠN VỊ PHỐI HỢP
       ===================================================== */
    t.ResponsibleUnit AS don_vi_phoi_hop,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetUser AS nguoi_thuc_hien_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(target_user.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(t.TargetUser AS CHAR)
    ) AS nguoi_thuc_hien_name,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO MỚI NHẤT
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(rp.CompletedProduct, ''),
        NULLIF(rp.Content, '')
    ) AS ket_qua,

    rp.Difficulty AS kho_khan,
    rp.Suggestion AS kien_nghi,

    /* =====================================================
       HẠN HOÀN THÀNH
       ===================================================== */
    t.ExpireDate AS han_hoan_thanh,

    /* =====================================================
       TRẠNG THÁI NHIỆM VỤ
       (trường hợp 'Chưa xác định' đã bị loại ở WHERE)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành - không có hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành - không có hạn'

        WHEN DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END AS trang_thai,

    /* =====================================================
       SỐ REPORT THEO STATUS (0 = Chờ duyệt, 1 = Đã duyệt, 2 = Từ chối)
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_cho_duyet, 0) AS so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_da_duyet, 0)  AS so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_tu_choi, 0)   AS so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG / NGÀY YÊU CẦU BÁO CÁO STATUS = 0 GẦN NHẤT
       ===================================================== */
    NULLIF(latest_pending_report.Content, '') AS bao_cao_cho_duyet_gan_nhat,
    latest_pending_report.CreatedDate         AS ngay_yeu_cau_bao_cao_gan_nhat

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

/* =========================================================
   ASSIGN DEPARTMENT
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department assign_dept
    ON assign_dept.id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1)

/* =========================================================
   TARGET DEPARTMENT
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department target_dept
    ON target_dept.id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1)

/* =========================================================
   ASSIGN USER / TARGET USER
   Danh bạ user đã khử trùng eGovUserId -> không nhân dòng.
   So sánh int = int trực tiếp (bỏ CAST AS CHAR để dùng được index)
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname) AS eGovUserFullname
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) assign_user
    ON assign_user.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname) AS eGovUserFullname
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) target_user
    ON target_user.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* =========================================================
   TASK -> RESOLUTION (TaskResolutionId lớn nhất của task)
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr2.TaskId,
        MAX(tr2.TaskResolutionId) AS TaskResolutionId
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr2
    GROUP BY tr2.TaskId
) last_tr
    ON last_tr.TaskId = t.TaskId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    ON tr.TaskResolutionId = last_tr.TaskResolutionId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
    ON r.ResolutionId = COALESCE(tr.ResolutionId, t.ResolutionId)

/* =========================================================
   THỐNG KÊ REPORT THEO TASK - QUÉT qlnv_report 1 LẦN, lấy luôn:
   - số báo cáo theo Status (0 = Chờ duyệt, 1 = Đã duyệt, 2 = Từ chối)
   - báo cáo mới nhất: COALESCE(UpdatedDate, CreatedDate) mới nhất,
     trùng -> ReportId lớn hơn (dùng cho ket_qua, kho_khan, kien_nghi)
   - báo cáo Status = 0 gần nhất: CreatedDate mới nhất, trùng -> ReportId lớn hơn

   MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER(): dựng khóa <yyyymmddhhmmss><ReportId 20 số>,
   MAX(khóa) rồi cắt lại ReportId từ ký tự thứ 15
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        rp_count.TaskId,

        SUM(rp_count.Status = 0) AS so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
        SUM(rp_count.Status = 1) AS so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
        SUM(rp_count.Status = 2) AS so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

        CAST(SUBSTRING(
            MAX(CONCAT(
                COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(rp_count.UpdatedDate, rp_count.CreatedDate), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '00000000000000'),
                LPAD(rp_count.ReportId, 20, '0')
            )), 15) AS UNSIGNED) AS latest_report_id,

        CAST(SUBSTRING(
            MAX(CASE
                WHEN rp_count.Status = 0
                THEN CONCAT(
                    COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(rp_count.CreatedDate, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '00000000000000'),
                    LPAD(rp_count.ReportId, 20, '0')
                )
            END), 15) AS UNSIGNED) AS latest_pending_report_id

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp_count

    WHERE rp_count.DeletedDate IS NULL

    GROUP BY rp_count.TaskId

) report_stats
    ON report_stats.TaskId = t.TaskId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp
    ON rp.ReportId = report_stats.latest_report_id

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report latest_pending_report
    ON latest_pending_report.ReportId = report_stats.latest_pending_report_id

/* =========================================================
   LOẠI VĂN BẢN
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        file_task.TaskId,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT file_task.Type
            ORDER BY file_task.Type
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS loai_van_ban_id,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN file_task.Type = 2
                    THEN 'Văn bản chỉ đạo thực hiện'

                WHEN file_task.Type = 3
                    THEN 'KH/HĐ chỉ đạo'

                WHEN file_task.Type = 4
                    THEN 'CTHĐ thực hiện'

                ELSE CONCAT(
                    'Loại ',
                    file_task.Type
                )
            END
            ORDER BY file_task.Type
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS loai_van_ban_name

    FROM (
        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN TASK
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            f.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f
        WHERE f.TaskId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL

        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN REPORT
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            rp_file.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f

        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp_file
            ON rp_file.ReportId = f.ReportId

        WHERE f.ReportId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL

        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN RESOLUTION
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            tr_file.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f

        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr_file
            ON tr_file.ResolutionId = f.ResolutionId

        WHERE f.ResolutionId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

    ) file_task

    GROUP BY file_task.TaskId

) file_info
    ON file_info.TaskId = t.TaskId

WHERE
    t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* KHÔNG LẤY TRẠNG THÁI 'Chưa xác định'
       (lọc thẳng trên qlnv_task thay cho bọc SELECT ngoài rồi lọc x.trang_thai;
        đồng thời đã loại Status = 5) */
    AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
         OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND (   t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                  OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)));

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

properties.Replacement Value:
/* Bảng phân quyền người dùng: đồng bộ từ qlnv_user + tên phòng ban.
   Cột permission (danh sách quyền dạng chuỗi JSON) mặc định = [DepartmentPath] của người dùng,
   chỉ điền khi đang NULL => quyền nhập tay sau này KHÔNG bị ghi đè. */

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_phanquyen_user` (
    user_id, user_name, egov_user_id, ho_ten, email, chuc_vu, chuc_vu_level,
    department_path, phong_ban_id, ten_phong_ban, duong_dan_phong_ban,
    is_super_admin, permission, sync_date
)
SELECT
    u.Id                    AS user_id,
    u.UserName              AS user_name,
    u.eGovUserId            AS egov_user_id,
    u.eGovUserFullname      AS ho_ten,
    u.Email                 AS email,
    u.eGovUserPositionName  AS chuc_vu,
    u.eGovUserPositionLevel AS chuc_vu_level,
    u.DepartmentPath        AS department_path,
    d.id                    AS phong_ban_id,
    d.name                  AS ten_phong_ban,
    d.departmentpath        AS duong_dan_phong_ban,
    u.IsSuperAdmin          AS is_super_admin,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.DepartmentPath, '') <> ''
         THEN CONCAT('["', u.DepartmentPath, '"]')
    END                     AS permission,
    '${sync_ts}'            AS sync_date
FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u

/* PHÒNG BAN CỦA NGƯỜI DÙNG = ID CUỐI CỦA DepartmentPath (vd 490.695.701.710 -> 710) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d
       ON d.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END

ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    user_name           = VALUES(user_name),
    egov_user_id        = VALUES(egov_user_id),
    ho_ten              = VALUES(ho_ten),
    email               = VALUES(email),
    chuc_vu             = VALUES(chuc_vu),
    chuc_vu_level       = VALUES(chuc_vu_level),
    department_path     = VALUES(department_path),
    phong_ban_id        = VALUES(phong_ban_id),
    ten_phong_ban       = VALUES(ten_phong_ban),
    duong_dan_phong_ban = VALUES(duong_dan_phong_ban),
    is_super_admin      = VALUES(is_super_admin),
    permission          = COALESCE(permission, VALUES(permission)),
    sync_date           = VALUES(sync_date);
